description: 在众人面前说几句：有故事、有笑点、有祝福，最后举杯。短、真诚、不抢新人风头。

targetChunks.en: I'm honored to say a few words.
targetChunks.note: 正式祝酒的开场，比 I want to speak 得体。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'm honored to say a few words tonight.

targetChunks.en: For those who don't know me, I'm the groom's sister.
targetChunks.zh: 不认识我的人，我是新郎的妹妹。
targetChunks.note: 介绍身份，让全场快速进入语境。
targetChunks.exampleEn: For those who don't know me, I'm the groom's sister.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 不认识我的人，我是新郎的妹妹。

targetChunks.en: I've known the groom for over twenty years.
targetChunks.zh: 我认识新郎二十多年了。
targetChunks.note: 用时间建立分量；后面接一个具体故事。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I've known the groom for over twenty years.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我认识新郎二十多年了。

targetChunks.en: The first time I met her, I knew she was different.
targetChunks.zh: 我第一次见她，就知道她不一样。
targetChunks.note: 夸新娘要具体、真诚，别只说 She's great。
targetChunks.exampleEn: The first time I met her, I knew she was different.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我第一次见她，就知道她不一样。

targetChunks.en: It's been a privilege watching them grow together.
targetChunks.zh: 看着他们一起成长是一种荣幸。
targetChunks.note: privilege 比 nice 更有分量，适合正式祝酒。
targetChunks.exampleEn: It's been a privilege watching them grow together.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 看着他们一起成长是一种荣幸。

targetChunks.en: Let's raise a glass to the happy couple.
targetChunks.zh: 让我们为这对新人举杯。
targetChunks.note: raise a glass to = 为……举杯，祝酒固定表达。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Let's raise a glass to the happy couple.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 让我们为这对新人举杯。

targetChunks.en: May you have a lifetime of laughter and good coffee.
targetChunks.zh: 愿你们一生都有欢笑和好咖啡。
targetChunks.note: May you have + 具体祝福，比 I wish you happiness 更有画面。
targetChunks.exampleEn: May you have a lifetime of laughter and good coffee.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 愿你们一生都有欢笑和好咖啡。

targetChunks.en: I'll keep this short — I know everyone wants cake.
targetChunks.zh: 我就说短点，我知道大家想吃蛋糕。
targetChunks.note: 婚礼祝酒的幽默收尾，能自然引出掌声。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'll keep this short — I know everyone wants cake.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我就说短点，我知道大家想吃蛋糕。

targetChunks.note: Here's to + 名词，简洁的祝酒句。
you two 比 both of you 更亲切。

targetChunks.en: I could not be happier for you.
targetChunks.zh: 我为你们高兴得不得了。
targetChunks.note: could not be happier = 最高级祝福，语气真诚。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I could not be happier for you both.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我为你们俩高兴得不得了。

roleplay.promptZh: 你是新郎的多年好友，要在婚礼上做 2 分钟祝酒：介绍自己、讲一个小故事、祝福新人、举杯。
roleplay.promptEn: You're the groom's old friend. Give a two-minute wedding toast: introduce yourself, tell a short story, offer a blessing, and raise a glass.
goals: 用一个具体故事带出笑点

script.speaker: you
script.en: I'm honored to say a few words. For those who don't know me, I'm the groom's old roommate.
script.zh: 很荣幸说几句。不认识我的人，我是新郎的老室友。

script.speaker: you
script.en: I've known him for over twenty years. So there I was, helping him move into his first flat, and he had packed three boxes of books and no bed.
script.zh: 我认识他二十多年了。当年帮他搬进第一间公寓，他打包了三箱书，却没带床。

script.speaker: you
script.en: Long story short, he slept on the floor for a week and called it character building.
script.zh: 长话短说，他睡了一周地板，还说这是磨练性格。

script.speaker: you
script.en: The first time I met her, I knew she was different — she was the only person who could make him plan more than a day ahead.
script.zh: 我第一次见她，就知道她不一样——只有她能让他提前一天以上做计划。

script.speaker: you
script.en: It's been a privilege watching them grow together. At the end of the day, that's what marriage is: choosing each other, again and again.
script.zh: 看着他们一起成长是一种荣幸。说到底，婚姻就是这样：一次又一次选择彼此。

script.speaker: you
script.en: May you have a lifetime of laughter and good coffee. I'll keep this short — I know everyone wants cake. Let's raise a glass to the happy couple.
script.zh: 愿你们一生都有欢笑和好咖啡。我就说短点，我知道大家想吃蛋糕。让我们为这对新人举杯。
